cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Hand me the drawer key before I sign the club accounts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. My signature covers the receipts too. Let me check how it adds up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you find a mistake, my name goes on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put mine beside yours. Give me the key and we'll correct it together before either name goes outside this room.

mechanism: A uses an old bookkeeping lesson and a willingness to share blame to persuade its pupil to release records for checking.
confusable: Not demanding authority for its own sake: A offers co-responsibility to remove the specific fear preventing access.
comparison: Private note excerpt versus shared checking and signatures.
